skills.name: add-i18n-strings
skills.description: Adds or changes user-facing text with next-intl, keeping every locale's messages file in key parity, using ICU plurals and variables, and handling RTL locales. Use whenever UI displays text to a user, when asked to "add a label/button/error message", "translate this", "localize this", or when a review flags a hardcoded string.
